items.name: GPT-6 Rosalind Research
items.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Rosalind Research on October 30, a frontier reasoning model for biology, drug discovery and translational medicine built on GPT-6 Astra's weights with no additional training. It is available only through a trusted-access programme for approved research organisations, with fewer refusals on dual-use biology queries but refusals retained for biological weaponisation.

items.name: Mistral Large 4 open weights
items.summary: Mistral released the weights of Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk) on October 29, an improved build after three more weeks of reinforcement learning following its October 6 preview. The roughly 1-trillion-parameter multimodal model leads open-weight coding benchmarks and scores 51% on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index for defensive security work, and can be downloaded and self-hosted under the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License.

items.name: Gemini 4 Carbon
items.summary: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Carbon on October 28, its strongest model yet, built for cybersecurity defence and long-horizon engineering work. It ranks first on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 at 59 and leads SEC-bench Pro (88.2%), ExploitGym (54.8%) and CWE-bench (71.0%), but rolls out first only to a subset of cyber defenders through the Fairwind Program.

items.name: Genie 4
items.summary: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4 on October 27, a new world model for real-time interactive simulation with greater photorealism, realistic physics and human movement, and natively generated audio including interactive dialogue. It is rolling out as a research preview for trusted testers, ahead of Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie and early API partners.

items.name: Kimi K3.1 Pro
items.summary: Moonshot AI launched Kimi K3.1 Pro on October 23, a heavily post-trained version of Kimi K3 with a 1-million-token context window that scores 65.7% on Terminal-Bench 4.0. Full weights are promised by November 4, and Moonshot says it removed cyber-related data from training for the open release so the open weights do not extend the frontier of offensive cyber capability.
